{# Header version switcher, styled to match pydata-sphinx-theme's built-in `.version-switcher__button` -- the same look NVIDIA Warp's docs use. Warp drives it with pydata's JavaScript switcher (populated from a published versions.json); we don't publish one, so we render the same markup/classes server-side from sphinx-multiversion's `versions`/`current_version` instead. Reusing the theme's classes means it inherits the switcher's border, hover ring, caret, and dropdown-menu styling for free. `current_version` comes from git and is populated per version by sphinx-multiversion, so the label is correct for every documented version (see the note in conf.py). The outer button is emitted unconditionally: pydata drops navbar items that render empty, and that check runs before sphinx-multiversion adds `current_version`/`versions` to the context, so the label and menu items fill in at final render. #} {%- macro version_label(name) -%} {{ name[8:] if name.startswith("release/") else name }} {%- endmacro -%} {#- `current_version` is only present under sphinx-multiversion; a plain single-version build (make html) has none, so fall back to a "dev" label for local previews. -#} {%- set label = version_label(current_version.name) if current_version else "dev" %}
{%- if versions %} {%- for item in versions.branches %} {{ version_label(item.name) }} {%- endfor %} {%- for item in versions.tags|reverse %} {{ version_label(item.name) }} {%- endfor %} {%- endif %}
